title: Connecting Past Events with Temporal Connectors

sections.content: Combine *cuando* and *mientras* with the pretérito indefinido to make a past narrative clearer. Use cuando to locate a completed event in time and mientras to connect actions that occurred together. Add simple sequence words such as *después* when you need another step.

items.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves.

items.spanish: Mientras trabajamos, hablamos con otras personas.
items.english: While we worked, we spoke with other people.

items.spanish: Cuando terminó la actividad, volvimos a casa.
items.english: When the activity ended, we went home.

sections.content: Use *cuando* to say when a completed event happened. Use *mientras* when two actions happened at the same time.
